items.separator: The captured showcase is an almost imperceptible hairline on a dark full-frame canvas with a tiny label. Excluded from the curated ready library on sampled visual readability; the raw upstream component remains available as reference source.
items.rgb-glitch-text: The upstream demo applies a dark ink default on a near-black background and overrides the showcase size while retaining zoom:0.28. All three sampled renders show an unreadably tiny, near-invisible word. Excluded until an explicitly adapted contrast/scale configuration is reviewed and reverified.
items.matrix-decode: Sampled frames at 15%, 50% and 85% remain zero glyphs. Source demo creates zeros and only animates their opacity and position; it never resolves data-final HYPERFRAMES. Excluded from ready references until an explicitly adapted and reverified implementation exists.
